name: Cicada Boy
summary: 7 day love story of a beautiful cicada prince and a post prime woman in her 30's.

name: No Gamble, No Future
summary: No Gamble, No Future is the newest cash game show from PokerGO that will see Eric Persson, Jean-Robert Bellande, Patrick Antonius, Sean Perry, Lynne Ji, Maria Ho, Eli Elezra, Jimmy D'Ambrosio, Dylan DeStefano, Nick Schulman, Krish Menon, David Williams, Alan Keating, and "Boston" Rob Mariano playing a variety of stakes up to $200/$400 No-Limit Hold'em with a $100,000 minimum buy-in.

name: Best Ed
summary: Best Ed follows two anamorphic animals, Ed and Buddy, a dog and a squirrel respectively, who live in the town of Swellville. Their adventures and sometimes mis-adventures usually cause them to interact with other characters. Overall, Ed tries to be happy and helpful at all times.

name: Kid Paddle
summary: There's a fine line between life and video games, and it doesn't take much to confuse the two, as Kid proves over and over.

name: Dayaa
summary: The story of Dayaa revolves around the titular character, a freezer van driver whose life takes an unexpected turn when he discovers a lifeless body inside his van. This shocking discovery sets off a series of tumultuous events that plunges him and his best friend into increasingly challenging circumstances.

name: The Inspired Unemployed (Impractical) Jokers
summary: The Inspired Unemployed (Impractical) Jokers features four lifelong mates competing to embarrass each other. They must do and say what they're told, if they refuse, they lose and face a humiliating punishment. Hidden cameras capture the chaos.

name: Toxic Town
summary: When dozens of babies in Corby are born with disabilities, their mothers embark on a battle to hold those responsible to account. Based on a true story.

previousepisode.name: El Imperio de los cuatro rumbos - los Incas Perúanos
Glasses Half Full / Meeting Frog Boy

name: Саша и Питер
summary: A lively girl Sasha finds out that her ex-boyfriend Ivan is going to get married. But he had been dating Sasha for more than ten years, and with a new passion for only six months. Moreover, he plans to celebrate the wedding in Sasha's favorite city – St. Petersburg. Sasha decides to take revenge on his ex-boyfriend and disrupt his wedding. For this, she moves to St. Petersburg and gets a job at the registry office.

name: Однажды в Абхазии
summary: Teymuraz is an employee of the Ministry of Emergency Situations of Abkhazia. After the death of his older brother, he inherited his debts, so he has been living with his parents, wife and two children in his mother-in-law's house for a long time. But trouble does not come alone. The local government is going to put radioactive waste for storage in the mine, in which the body of grandfather Teymuraz tragically died and rests. Several attempts to reach the authorities and stop the approaching catastrophe do not lead to success. In order to achieve justice, Teymuraz decides to nominate his candidacy for the post of president of the republic.

name: Плакса
summary: Masha is a schoolgirl from Moscow, who studies at the gymnasium on Rublevka. When her family moves to Novoorsk, Masha enters an ordinary secondary school, where the attitude to the problems of students is completely different. The girl immediately has enemies: Chris, the local ringleader, incites classmates against the new girl, who easily spoil her life. As luck would have it, Masha wakes up feelings for the young man Chris. To deal with her moral problems, she gathers a rock band called "Plaksa".

name: Секс. До и после
summary: About what leads to sex, and what happens immediately after it. In one of the novels, a guy agrees to have a child with his best friend, unaware of her insidious plan. In another, a casual acquaintance makes a vegan wonder if sex contradicts her beliefs. And the dispute between two strangers about feminism is resolved in bed, where a woman is not going to remain in debt to a man. The heroes of the stories tell not about sex, but about what surrounds it.

name: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You
summary: Rentarou Aijou has confessed to (and been rejected by) 100 girls in his lifetime. On the last day of middle school, he visits a shrine and prays that he get a girlfriend during his time at high school. Suddenly, the God of Love appears and tells Rentarou that the reason for his non-existent love life is because everyone is only supposed to have one soulmate in their life, but due to an error on the God of Love's part, Rentarou is destined to have 100.

previousepisode.name: The 17 Girlfriends Who I Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love

name: Spellbound
summary: Cece Parker Jones' life is turned upside-down when she discovers she's a real witch. Magical mayhem ensues at the Paris Opera Ballet School when Cece begins to practice her spell work, making things harder to juggle as she balances new magical identity, dance, and simply being a teenager! Things get even more complicated when she accidentally summons her enemies, a group called the Mystics.

name: Wu Nao Monu
summary: Agate is a demon girl cursed with an eternal life. To forget the past, she throws half of her head into a deep valley and runs away. Unexpectedly, the tears flood the valley floor and form into a lake, triggering a flood in hell. Aloys, the Prince of Ghost comes to the Human World to find out the truth and finally finds the demon girl, starting a story of life and love.

name: Great Australian Walks
summary: Great Australian Walks with Julia Zemiro is set to take viewers across our Great Southern Land by foot in an entertaining waltz through history, geography, science, travel, and culture.

previousepisode.name: Juan for All and All for Juan (2)

name: Sweet Games
summary: The campus belle An Ran pretended to be a "winner" to gain investment, but she was exposed in front of other people. She got drunk and accidentally had a one-night stand with her younger landlord Yan Yue. She found out that Yan Yue was not only the popular voice actor Hei Sha, but also was the cooperative partner of next project.

name: The Legend of Zhuohua
summary: It tells the story of Mu Zhuohua, a career-driven woman who rebels against the traditional institution of marriage and strives for success, and Liu Yan, a valiant warrior burdened with national enmity and family feud. They find redemption in each other, developing a deep understanding and love. Together, they join forces to defend their country, overcome external threats, and ultimately become people who follow their hearts and embrace challenges.

name: I'm a Stripper
summary: I'm a Stripper follows the lives of male strippers in the sexiest cities in North America. Each guy has been selected to create a dynamic perspective on the reality of making a living in the buff.

name: Jumping the Apex
summary: The Halifax Harbour Grudges face their toughest season yet as they get the chance to compete on the international track. But can they maintain their small-town charm while evolving into a world-class roller derby team?

name: Founder
summary: What does it take to create something from nothing? Founder goes behind the scenes, profiling Australian tech startup founders Melanie Perkins (Canva), Luke Anear (SafetyCulture), Katherine McConnell (Brighte), and Fred Schebesta (Finder).

name: Sjukt
summary: A coming-of-age comedy drama partly inspired by the experiences of writer Lisa Ambjörn, Sjukt stars Carla Sehn as Alice, who discovers she has cervical cancer, loses her job in London and is left by her boyfriend. She must return home to Sweden, facing up to old bullies and troublesome parents as she attempts to rebuild her life.

name: Le Mystère des Mayas, des origines à la chute
summary: Le Mystère des Mayas, des origines à la chute tells the entire story of the great Mayan civilization, which inhabited areas that are now regions of Central America.

previousepisode.name: Les Mayas, ont-ils survecu à leur chute ?

name: Romina Poderosa
summary: Romina is a brave young woman who is passionate about Urban Downhill, a sport recognized worldwide for its high dose of risk. A tragedy caused by violence took away those she loves the most, therefore she will change her life completely by posing as her twin sister, Laura, to investigate the truth about her past.

previousepisode.name: Romina tiene un enfrentamiento de vida o muerte entre Los Chitiva y Virginia

name: Dhindora
summary: It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

name: Sandeep Bhaiya
summary: Traces Sandeep's own journey, from his childhood in Prayagraj to his own struggle with the UPSC entrance exam attempts and their preparation.

name: Court Martial: Soldiers Behind Bars
summary: Life at the Military Corrective Training Centre with soldiers who've broken the law.

name: A Town Without Seasons
summary: Bereft of hope, Shinsuke Tanaka, aka Shorts Hansuke, comes with his cat Tora, to the temporary housing settlement that still remains twelve years after the great disaster known as The What. His job is to report to the shady Mikimoto on the lives of the residents, every last one of which is a quirky screwball: Roku-chan, the driver of an invisible train; a homeless father and son who daydream of someday building a mansion; a father who has many children after marrying a pop idol who came to visit the disaster victims; two drunken married couples who argue endlessly, and a young girl Ganmodoki, who labors away silently at home making masks.

name: The 1970s Supermarket
summary: The story of the shopping revolution, as Britain went from small behind-the-counter shops to massive megastores, with trolleys, booze sections and barcodes.

name: Spy Ops
summary: Intelligence operatives from MI6 to the CIA share insider stories of spy craft, Cold War campaigns, and coups carried out by covert agents.

name: Castle Farm
summary: Join Farm Girl, Piggy, Farmer and all the gang for fun and laughter!

name: Workdol
summary: (G)I-DLE member Shuhua explores Korean part-time jobs.

previousepisode.name: Thought We'd "Work Like Dogs"… So We Caught Strays | Animal Control | Workdol | fromis_9 Jiwon

name: The Royal Borough: Kensington and Chelsea
summary: Series exploring hundreds of years of history and delving into the lives of the royals and the super rich who inhabit the wealthiest district in Britain.

name: Jane McDonald: Lost in Japan
summary: The presenter travels across Japan on an epic adventure.

name: Crazy Handsome Rich
summary: Thad's wealthy family has hired a new butler, Luv. Ever since Luv entered the house, Thad hasn't been able to keep his eyes off the new hire, and has been offering him plenty of attention all the time. Is it a coincidence or fate that the necklaces the two of them wear are similar; was it their destiny to meet?

name: Объяснялкины
summary: A family that shoots an educational show signs a streaming contract, and according to the contract, the characters cannot grow old and die, and must also live in the apartment of elderly parents. Batek, Mom, Grandfather and Grandmother in each episode answer the question that their Son asks them. Once the family considered this show to be a lamp show and enjoyed filming, but now they are sick of everything. They can't break the contract, change something in their lives and stop explaining, so the Explainers decide to sabotage the process and admit to everyone that they are far from an ideal family, so that the producer himself fired them.

name: Naiste sõda
summary: As the year 1941 dawns, a small Tallinn gentleman's club, ran by the ever vigorous Mrs Kukk, has to pull out all the stops to stay in business. Boudoirs have become the domain of espionage and intrigue and courtesans have become soldiers in war - the outcome of which could be decided in the bedroom.

name: Killjoy Comedy
summary: Get to know six comedians who are staging a stand-up laugh riot. Killjoy Comedy puts the mic in front of comics who are re-writing the old insult comedy playbook.

name: Volha
summary: Standa Pekárek has three wishes in life: to drive a volga, to drive for the Humour and Folk Entertainment editorial office and to drive Got'ák. The five-part miniseries Volha is an adaptation of the novel of the same name by Karel Hynia, written in an extraordinary, bizarre and precisely echoed language. It can be perceived as a peculiar history of Czechoslovak television with a number of incredible, albeit real, "stories from the set". At the same time, however, it is a portrait of its main character - a limited egocentric who excels in inventing small tricks and deceptions - how to steal petrol, fake mileage, cheat his wife, get rid of the competition. Logically, he then also becomes a StB collaborator (with the code name Volha) who informs on all his co-workers and passengers without any remorse.

name: Skippy: Adventures in Bushtown
summary: The adventures of Skippy the Bush Kangaroo.

name: Supermodels
summary: Welcome to a world of dreams and fantasy, full of mystery and intrigue. Travel from the runways of Paris to the most exciting places, where nothing is as it seems - and enjoy this soundtrack's great pop and classic music hits.

name: Krummernes Jul
summary: It is December, and the whole of Denmark is ready to celebrate Christmas. But for one (almost) completely ordinary family, Christmas has come as a big surprise. We are of course talking about the Krumborg Family - better known as the Krummers. Grandpa wants to celebrate Christmas, but big sister Stine does not want to! Krummemor wants to have a do-it-yourself Christmas, while Krumme is busy proving that Santa Claus exists. Little brother Grunk writes letters to Santa every day, but because he is the only one, Santa finds it difficult to get in the Christmas mood.

name: Martine à la plage
summary: Martine Racra's life is hazy. At 14, at the start of the holidays and with an absent father, she is bored. Then, Gilbert Marcel, his optometrist neighbour, prescribed his first pair of glasses. Martine falls madly in love. To see Gilbert again, she is ready to do anything, even ruin her eyesight.

name: Filles du feu
summary:
1609, Basque Country. Coming from a long line of abortionists-healers, three sisters see their lives endangered by the arrival of judge Pierre de Lancre in the region. Hostile and terrified of women's freedom and knowledge, he will lead what will be one of the deadliest witch hunts in France.
Plunged into a nightmare, our three sisters find themselves having to fight, each in their own way, to try to survive...
Inspired by a real story.

name: Pokémon: Path to the Peak
summary: Ava feels out of place at her new school until she discovers the Pokémon Trading Card Game in this four-part animated series.

name: You Are Desire
summary:
After Lin Yujing's parents' divorce, she and her dad moved to a new city where she becomes seat mates with notoriously "ill-tempered" Shen Juan at their new school. They get reacquainted, separated and reunited again in university.

Lin Yujing was initially full of anxiety about readjusting to a blended family after her father's remarriage, but she is warmly welcomed by her stepmother and stepbrother Fu Mingxiu. She also thought it would be difficult to integrate into a new group, but she quickly meets interesting classmates at her new school. Her arrival also brings changes to Shen Juan, her new seat mate who was held back a year.

Just as her life was gradually getting back on track, Lin Yujing's mother, Lin Zhi, forcibly takes her back to her hometown. A year later, she is reunited with Shen Juan in university. She learns that Shen Juan's family has gone through some hard times and he still hasn't recovered from the trauma. With the help of Lin Yujing and their classmates, Shen Juan slowly walks out of the haze. Lin Yujing also finds her own direction in life.

name: À tout prix
summary: Charles and Laurence are unable to have children naturally, and decide to turn to assisted procreation. They will have to deal with specialists, appointments, paperwork and their loved ones, who all have an opinion on their approach.

name: France, tour, détour, deux enfants
summary: A series in which the auteur interrogates a boy and a girl from two families in an attempt to get back to the origins of language and movement.

name: Grabouillon
summary: The adventures of an eager pup and his 5-year-old human, Petunia are told by Loopdidoo. These two best friends bring a lot of fun along with a lot of mischief each day. Sometimes they're joined by their feline nemesis, who keeps the dog on his toes with his antics.

previousepisode.name: Les maths, c'est pas du gâteau

name: Open Bar
summary: Open Bar, based on Fabcaro's albums, features a gallery of characters that are a priori classic but here always a little borderline when they are grappling with the daily life of Western civilization. Situations that get out of hand under the effect of surrealist reactions thus revealing the absurdity of human existence in areas of high urban concentration.

previousepisode.name: La chaleur monte à la tête

name: Birdz
summary: Eddy Storkowitz is an imaginative, inquisitive and precocious ten year old bird. Through his eyes, we discover a world in which human qualities are endowed upon our fine feathered friends. Birdz characters work in places like The Worm Factory, eat at the nearby Fly-Through Restaurant and retire at the Home For Endangered Species.

name: All the Way to the Sun
summary: Li Mujia, a girl from Beidiao, entered the most famous law firm in Beijing after graduation, and relied on her own hard work to become an independent lawyer from an administrative assistant. Get acquainted with Li Guang, a shopping mall elite, and their relationship has experienced several twists and turns while growing rapidly; best friend Tian Rong failed to apply for a job after graduation, became a real estate agency by mistake, and married Li Wanbing, a Beijing boy, in a hurry. The test; the two encountered various setbacks but found what they wanted. From 2007 to 2019, the girls' pursuit and hope for life involuntarily changed their appearance in reality. Fortunately, after ten years of hard work, they finally found the sunny side of life and were able to face the sun all the way.

name: Mignon
summary:
After losing his parents at a young age, Mignon lives as a mechanic by day, and a cage fighter by night at an illegal arena. Living a life of exploitation and violence, the only person who gives him any attention is Oh Young-One, a doctor at the illegal arena.

"I'll do anything…! I… I can help you!"

Despite knowing Young-One's true identity, Mignon's pure and blind love for him causes Young-One to start slowly opening his heart. But the hellish reality that surrounds Mignon starts to shake up even Young-One's life!

name: Honest Renovations
summary: Join Jessica Alba and Lizzy Mathis as they take on the ultimate renovation challenge: transforming family homes that just aren't cutting it into stunning spaces as functional as they are fabulous.

name: Gong Zhu De Jiao Huan Ren Sheng
Beyond the Star
summary: The story of KJ Agency, a well-known agency plans to create and produce a series. Including the artists development therefore gathering young people who have dreams join the Beyond the Star project to develop capabilities in all aspects of the entertainment industry, but on the process to become a superstar. There will always be obstacles. Love, commitment, or dreams, which ones are more important?

name: Animated Tales of the World
summary: Each episode of the series retells international story tales that has originated in many countries around the world, such as Poland, Scotland, Russia, etc.

previousepisode.name: The Boy Who Had No Story (Ireland)

name: Legend of Xianwu
summary: Exiled from his sect and left homeless, Ye Chen, a discarded disciple, stumbles upon a fortuitous encounter: the acquisition of true fire. With this newfound power, he sets foot once again on the path of cultivation. In this world where gods, demons, immortals, and Buddhas coexist, and amidst the chaos of countless realms, Ye Chen embarks on an extraordinary journey defying the heavens. Through hardships and reincarnations, he ultimately ascends to the pinnacle of the Great Dao.

name: Mad Master
summary: There is a serious generation gap between the cold-hearted granddaughter and the relaxed and funny grandpa. An accidental coincidence caused the two souls to exchange, and they were inexplicably involved in a murder case. Through the unremitting efforts of the "big" granddaughter and the "little" grandpa, finally Bring criminals to justice.

name: Jeopardy!
summary: Based on the hit US show, Stephen Fry hosts the quiz in which players are presented with clues in the form of answers and must phrase their responses in the form of a question.

name: UFO Cowboys
summary: A team of cowboys uses ancient tracking techniques and modern technology to investigate mysterious extraterrestrial activity throughout the American West.

name: Canis Familiaris
summary: Max has everything to be happy: a luxurious house, a loving family, a group of loyal friends. But for many weeks, depression has taken a toll on him, and he is now questioning everything and looking for a meaning in his life. It is a midlife crisis. If Max were a man, he might go and see a psychologist. But the truth of the matter is that Max is a 7-year-old Labrador.

name: Septième ciel
summary: When Jacques' daughter places him in a residence for the elderly, he thinks he is being sent to the slaughterhouse. He is far from suspecting that he will meet Rose there, desire her and be desired like never before. This real physical passion upsets those around them, questions everyone's libido and causes chaos within the residence. Despite the reluctance and prohibitions against them, will Jacques and Rose manage to love each other?

name: Méditerranée, l'odyssée pour la vie
summary: The Mediterranean Sea, one of the centers of European civilisation, has been exploited for centuries by the countries bordering it. However, wildlife continues to develop there valiantly, developing treasures of invention and adaptability to survive human depredations. For four years, teams of passionate documentarians, with the help of scientists and specialists, investigated to bring back the most evocative and spectacular images of this struggle. Back on this extraordinary experience.

name: Désobéir : le choix de Chantale Daigle
summary: Chantale Daigle, at the age of 21, falls in love and then pregnant with Jean-Guy Tremblay, a man who will prove to be manipulative and aggressive. After a stormy relationship, she leaves him, chooses to have an abortion... but Jean-Guy, wounded in his pride and eager to maintain their relationship, appeals to justice to prevent it. Against all odds, a judge agrees with Jean-Guy. Will she find the strength to assume her choice until the end?

name: La Fille au cœur de cochon
summary: Nina, a teenager with a heart condition and daughter of a hypermarket owner, sees her outlook on the world turned upside down when she learns that she has always lived thanks to a pig valve transplanted to her heart. Hugo, son of industrial pig breeders, is in love with Nina. So when she decides to save the life of Fleur, a sow destined for slaughter, Hugo does not hesitate and embarks with her on a crazy road trip, with the authorities on their heels, to save the life of this innocent pig.

name: La secte
summary: Finding 23 dead after a midnight fire on a farm in the Swiss mountains, at the same time as finding 25 dead only 1o kilometers away at another farm. The signs of a sect.

name: Temple Solaire, l'enquête impossible
summary: After a series of fatal and mysterious events, Swiss, French and Quebec police officers and three journalists embark on an international investigation to understand the incomprehensible. One thing leading to another, between strange encounters and exhibits, they trace the trail of one of the most obscure and fascinating sects of the 80s and 90s.

name: Space Game
summary: The funny adventures of the employees of a Parisian video game store and their customers ...

name: Full Count
summary: A single pitch can change fate or make a miracle. Ten Korean professional baseball teams boast a history of over forty years. Their battle to be the last champion standing begins in this never-ending showdown.

name: The Forbidden Woman
summary: The financial prodigy Xiang Wei who dared to love and hate was cheated because of the joint betrayal of her husband and sister. Then inexplicably traveled to the parallel world, using her superb business acumen to perfectly counterattack and revenge. In the field of love and betrayal, what kind of changes will this thorny journey bring to Xiang Wei?

name: Please, Don't Chase Me
summary: Young actress Shen Qingqing acknowledges that she is a loser in love. One day, she magically enters the world of the costume drama that she acted in to become Huayan, the new city lord of Hualing City. With Qiao Yu's help, she begins her journey of self-growth and also finds true love.

name: Podezrení
summary: After a mysterious death in hospital, Nurse Hana becomes the first suspect. How far does the presumption of innocence go?

name: Who Stole My Kiss
summary: Han Tingting who dreams to become the "Romance Queen" is a white-collar planner in a love game company. After a gathering of the project team, she got drunk and dreamed of a white-shirt guy approaching her, shyly and gently kissing her. After she woke up, she realised that she was kissed but she can't remember who kissed her. Could it be the best game planner, Lu Bai, who is cold on the outside but heartwarming? Or the idol, Qin Mochi? Or the young kid, Lu Yuanyu? Or her childhood friend who has liked her for many years, He Rang? Han Tingting starts testing everyone...

name: Labyrint
summary: Fredrik, Zahra, Jonny, Filippa and Carl are five young Urban's. By accident they lose control of their lives and dragged into a myriad of good, evil, black and white. In the middle of the night club Blue.

name: The Wanderer
summary: In this series, Tripadvisor challenges travelers to curate a travel guide uniquely inspired by locals and reviews. With little to no knowledge of what to expect, wanderers will immerse themselves into a transformative journey of exploration, self-discovery, and reflection, ultimately showing the beauty of traveling as one of the most ancient means of discovery.

previousepisode.name: Morocco: A Vibrant Tapestry of Colors

name: Music Bank
summary: Keeping a pulse on the South Korean music market, experience Korean songs and hits of nearly every genre, including K-pop, ballads, and hip-hop on various stages by talented singers.

name: Spaghetti Family
summary: The Spaghetti family is an average Italian family, large and rather chaotic, with children always in argument with their parents. The only thing that brings them together is their love for spaghetti.

name: Ach Du Heilige Scheibe
summary: Mimo is supposed to become the leader of the village where the famous sky disc is kept. At least that's what his father, the current leader, wants. But Mimo prefers to dream that it would be fairer if everyone could have a say. His sister Leva, on the other hand, would much rather become a leader herself. The siblings and their goat are constantly experiencing new adventures that have to be faced with courage, understanding and humor.

name: Made in Chelsea: Corsica
summary: It's summer, and the Chelsea gang are off to live the island life in the sunny climes of Corsica. But the drama doesn't take a holiday...

previousepisode.name: I Can't Help But Think I've Just Started a War

name: Paris Paris
summary: In Paris, Ontario Philippe finds a tunnel that leads him to Paris, France where he creates a second, idealized French life away from his duties as a husband and father. But what happens when one life starts to impact the other?

name: The Leading Actor Dare Not Provoke
Absolute Zero
summary: Suansoon and Ongsa are in a relationship, but an accident occurred when Ongsa rushed to celebrate Suansoon's birthday. Wracked with guilt, Suansoon wishes to go back in time to prevent their relationship. Unexpectedly, he finds himself in the past, warning a younger Ongsa about their future, but Ongsa doesn't believe him and still pursues Suansoon. A decade later, an older Ongsa returns to convince his younger self not to avoid the accident, as Suansoon's life depends on it. Ongsa allows the accident to happen. Transported back to the past, he decides not to approach Suansoon this time, determined to change their fate.

name: Alison & Larry: Billlericay to Barry
summary: Alison Steadman and Larry Lamb take a journey down memory lane on a 210-mile road trip from Billericay in Essex to Barry Island in South Wales.

name: Say Yes to the Dress with Tan France
summary: Fashion superstar, Tan France, takes his expertise to the English countryside in order to help a lucky group of brides-to-be choose their dream wedding dress at a special bridal salon.

name: Rosie Jones's Disability Comedy Extravaganza
summary: Rosie Jones is joined by a host of fellow comedians for a celebration of disability and laughs.

name: The Kidnapping Day
summary: A special collaboration between the clumsy kidnapper Kim Myung Joon and an 11-year-old genius girl Roh Hee. Myung Joon is a first-time kidnapper who kidnaps a girl to pay for his daughter's hospital bills. He is suddenly chased as a murder suspect due to an unexpected incident. For some reason, the truth tracking of the kidnapper, who is lacking 2% but is human and weak-hearted, and the girl who is smart, is expected to be fun and touching.

name: Legend of Wacken
summary: In Legend of Wacken, the story of how the legendary heavy metal festival came to be is fictionalized. The six-part series focuses on the two founders Thomas Jensen and Holger Hübner, who turned their dream into reality with a great deal of passion and dedication and brought the Wacken Open Air to life. The main roles of the two founders are played by Charly Hübner and Aurel Manthei.

name: Britain's Newsroom
summary: Andrew and Bev present every weekday morning. When the news happens, it happens here. But what does it mean for you? GB News brings you the biggest stories and the answers you need from across the UK.

name: The Live Desk
summary: Every weekday from midday, Mark and Pip bring you the news as it breaks. Wherever it's happening, we'll have it covered – as well as giving our own view and how it matters to you.

name: Stand By Me
summary: In Shanghai in the year 1936, Huang Weijie, a member of the patriotic organization, happened to meet Feng Guanyu, a patriotic businessman, during his mission. The two were childhood friends who separated due to a misunderstanding. Feng Guanyu forced him to be his bodyguard. Although the two have constant conflicts, in the face of common adversity, the two with ideals of justice join hands and heroically devote themselves to the cause of patriotism.

name: The History of Home Presents: History's Greatest Homes
summary: Explore some of the greatest homes ever built in the United States and find out their unique history.

name: The Wonderful World of Baby Animals
summary: Baby animals are observed throughout the first couple of months after birth.

previousepisode.name: Lenny M'Bunga, Walid Jabbari, Soun Dembele, Richard Sabak, Lala, Ilyes Mela,Sophie Loustalot, Islem Sehiki, Thomas sii et Umut Köker

name: Evolution Earth
summary: Discover how new animal behaviors are revealing insights into the story of our changing planet. Traveling to extreme locations, distant wild lands and modern urban environments, this five-part series meets both animals and people on the front lines of climate change and offers a look at how Earth is evolving at superspeed.

name: Top Guns: Inside the RAF
summary: At a time of increased global tension, this new series has unprecedented access to the fighter jets, war planes and service personnel at RAF Lossiemouth.

name: Go Wild
summary: Young environmental enthusiast Aneeshwar along with his friends Steve Backshall and Lizzie Daly meet amazing animals and reveal the surprising and unusual ways in which they are connected in the wild.

name: The Duchess and Her Magical Kingdom
summary: With exclusive access to Alnwick Castle, Jane Percy, The Duchess of Northumberland, welcomes us to her incredible home. Known for her brave projects, Jane's about to embark on her biggest one yet: a magical kingdom for little and big kids alike.

name: Behind Closed Doors
summary: Counter-espionage adventure series based on the files and experience of retired Rear Adm. Ellis M. Zacharias.

name: Kill You Love You
summary: Su Xianling is a novice assassin with zero experience and one day she snatches an order from her fellow clan to assassinate the current lord of the city, Dongfang Jing. With murderous intentions abounding throughout the palace, Dongfang Jing has no choice but to disguise himself as a clueless idiot in order come across as non-threatening to those hungering for power. In reality he is brave and resourceful, guarded and wary, until he finds himself opening up to and falling in love with the sweet Su Xianling.

name: Mr. Gay Canada
summary: A documentary about a group of gay men who have entered the Mr. Gay Canada competition, which takes a look at the competition through the eyes of the winner, Darren Bruce.

name: Ready Jet Cook
summary: Jet Tila shares his favorite go-to recipes and shops at his family's grocery store.

name: Miami Dolls
summary: Go behind the scenes of Palace Bar, Miami's hottest drag venue. Packed with laughs, drama, and explosive performances from the countries top showgirls.

name: The Ruling Class
summary: The Ruling Class profiles members of the social and business elite who use their outsized influence to manipulate the world around them.

name: The Jengaburu Curse
summary: Follows London-based financial analyst, Priya Das. When her father goes missing, she is forced to come back to Odisha. As she starts to search him that unravel an unlikely connection between the Bondia tribe and the mining state of Odisha.

name: Hôtel du temps
summary: Hôtel du Temps is a new kind of biopic that uses artificial intelligence to recreate long-lost legends and tell them about their lives. For one evening, Thierry Ardisson will bring culture and entertainment stars back to life. It invites viewers to rediscover these cult personalities in their most iconic appearance through interviews, duplexes with other legends, as well as professional, family or historical archives.

name: En Studio
summary: In the studio offers people of all ages the unique luck to record a striking song of their lives, in the company of Marc Dupré and professionals in the music industry.

name: Goryeo-Khitan War
summary: A story of King Hyeonjong of Goryeo and Commander-in-Chief Gang Gam Chan. They unite the people of Goryeo to one and lead a war against Khitan.

name: Laissez-vous guider
summary: Stéphane Bern and Lorànt Deutsch, two great history and heritage enthusiasts, have set themselves a friendly and fun challenge. They will in turn take on the role of tourist guide to try to surprise themselves during an exceptional visit to Paris for one, and Marseille for the other.

name: OUT for Laughs
summary: The funniest LGBTQ+ Standup Comedy in Canada!

name: One Shot: Overtime Elite
summary: One Shot: Overtime Elite follows brothers Amen and Ausar Thompson, who made NBA history as the first brothers recruited in the top five during the same draft cycle. Throughout the series, audiences will receive a behind-the-scenes peek into the brothers' pursuit of careers in professional basketball and their experiences within the Overtime Elite league, the professional basketball league for 16-20 year olds around the globe.

name: Li'l Horrors
summary: Li'l Horrors is a puppet sitcom set in a spooky old house owned by Morbidda Bates, a retired horror movie actress. The series follows the misadventures of the Li'l Horrors as they squabble, tease and laugh, and generally have a monster of a time. In many ways, it is really just your average school for Li'l Horrors. It is classsy and comical and packed with monsterly fun.

name: Hier, aujourd'hui, demain
summary: Laurent Ruquier addresses several major social and current phenomena, first contextualized thanks to archives told by Thierry Ardisson, then emblematic personalities, experts or anonymous, will come to debate on set, compare yesterday to today, and evoke tomorrow !

name: Tahir's House
summary: When a Saudi family learns that their fish shop is about to go broke, they harness their granny's green thumb to be first to a blossoming new market.

name: Heart of Invictus
summary: Follow six people competing in the 2022 Invictus Games, a global event founded by Prince Harry that helps wounded service members heal through sports.

name: Never Apart TV
summary: Explore the Montreal art scene with Michael Venus.

name: The US East Coast
summary: From Florida's beautiful beaches to Maine's Indian summers, travel along the United States' East Coast without driving up Interstate 95!

name: Kitty 911
summary: This docu-series follows the passionate group of volunteers who run the Vancouver Orphan Kitten Rescue Association or VOKRA, a no-kill, non-profit, registered charity dedicated to the rescue of cats and kittens.

name: The Inheritance
summary:
The Inheritance follows siblings Daniel, Sian and Chloe who are part of a seemingly close and loving family. The trio are left reeling after the sudden death of their father, Dennis and are later devastated to discover they have not been left their expected inheritance in his will.

This leads them to question whether he really did die in an accident, as they were told, or if he was murdered. Their investigation takes them down a dangerous path and sees secrets unravel, relationships ripped apart and lives lost.

name: LT-21
summary: The LT-21 virus hits France and begins to spread around the world. He will not make a single death. But are we still quite alive when we have forgotten everything? Because infected patients develop total retrograde amnesia. Asia and Gabriel, a couple of doctors, are doing everything to stop the epidemic and protect patients detained in a hospital under Army surveillance. By helping an infected young boy, Gabriel gets sick. Soon he will have forgotten everything about his identity and his love story with Asia. And when Asia is exfiltrated against her will on a mysterious island guarded by the military, she thinks she can never find the man she loves. On this island, the secret base of Operation Heredis, handpicked intellectuals were sheltered from the virus. The goal: to preserve their memory to prepare the World after. A World where nothing would change, dominated by the powerful. What if forgetting everything was an opportunity for a new start for humanity? This is the thesis defended by a group of resistance fighters, La Métanoïa, determined to let the virus run and do its work...

name: Nubia Amplified: The Series
summary: Nubia Amplified is a call to action aimed to activate global communities to keep up the good fight through powerful storytelling and no-holds barred exchanges.

name: My Friend Rabbit
summary: Mouse works together with his best friend Rabbit and a group of animals to solve problems.

name: History of Grace
summary: In her beloved car, "Grace", a wife is on her way to Narita. Following a bus accident that kills her, her husband, Kikuo, gets access to her GPS which contains the history of all the places she travelled to without his knowledge. Suspecting infidelity, Kikuo embarks on a journey to trace the history of the cars GPS in order to solve the mystery.

name: 48 Hours Weekday Edition
summary: 48 Hours Weekday Edition will launch this fall in weekday syndication, and will run Monday through Friday nationwide starting on Monday, Sept. 11.

name: The HEAL Project
summary: After more than two years of being separated, The Rose reunites to work on their new album "HEAL." Their first full length album opens up the creative process to their fans around the world in hopes of starting a conversation about mental health and how music has helped them get through tough times. As the band navigates through personal stories submitted by their fans, they reconnect with each other and strengthen their bonds.

name: Boot Dreams: Now or Never
summary: Sixteen footballers rejected by top clubs join a unique camp. Can help with their issues off the pitch get them a new professional contract? Mentors include Bruno Fernandes. With Roman Kemp.

name: The Cruise: Fun-Loving Brits at Sea
summary: Following groups of Brits as they cruise around the Mediterranean's most glamorous spots.

name: The 100 Days
summary: Explore the first 100 days of the most pivotal moments in history with The 100 Days. The dramatic series provides an ample perspective on the timing of these defining, 20th-century world events and gives context to what happened leading up to, during, and at the close.

name: Fryktens øyeblikk
summary: In the documentary series we go into dramatic events and talk to people who have each been exposed to a strong fear and survived. Some of these events are the result of a calculated risk, others are about being in the wrong place at the wrong time.

name: Zehirli Sarmaşık
summary: Yakut and Sinem are two close friends. When Yakut's mother falls ill, Sinem and Yahut set out together. But Yahut's mother, Ms. Mesude, has already passed away. While Yakut is struggling with the pain of losing his mother, Sinem finds the letter left for Yakut. When Sinem sees what is written in the letter, she decides to destroy it. In the letter, it is written that Yakut's real mother is Ceyla Benderli, a well-known person in the country and a wealthy woman. Yakut, who is unaware of the existence of her real mother, is the girl that Ceyla's stepson Derin fell in love with at first sight. However, fate has other plans for Yakut. Sinem, who grew up in an orphanage, realizes that all these years she was jealous of Mesude Hanım, whom she thought was Yakut's mother. However, he cannot tell the truth to Yakut. Finally, he decides to get to know Ceyla Benderli and her surroundings better and makes a terrible plan for this. He decided to enter Benderli Farm once.

name: Legend of the Undercover Chef
summary: At the end of some dynasty, wokou pirates run amuck and the eunuchs had the imperial power in their hands. Eunuch Cao of the Eastern Bureau colludes with the wokou pirates to slaughter the people of the Chinese martial arts world and plot a rebellion. Changhai is known as the leader of the Magpie Saber Sect and actually a member of a secret anti-wokou-pirate organization. Apart from wiping out the wokou pirates, his other important task is to discover the officials who collude with the wokou pirates. Meanwhile, Eunuch Cao also finds that some martial artists are opposing him, so he secretly assigns his people to monitor all sects. To conceal his identity and proceed with his secret task, Ximen Changhai finds his twin brother, Ximen Changzai, who is living in their hometown, and asks the latter to disguise him. Twins as they are, Ximen Changhai and Ximen Changzai are utterly distinctive in character and choice of life. Ximen Changzai is a vigilant hero while Ximen Changhai is a timid cook. Facing his brother's daring request, Ximen Changzai doesn't agree at first but allured by Changhai's promise to get him a wife, Ximen Changzai still agrees to disguise himself as his brother. As such, Ximen Changzai becomes a leader of a sect and breaks into the thrilling martial arts world. To disguise himself as his brother, the first hurdle Ximen Changzai has to face is his brother's family, aka, Hao Meng, the eldest disciple who is dull and staid, Ms. Ye, who is extremely passionate, Zhao Dezhu, the second disciple, who is reckless and impulsive, and Ximen Rou, the daughter of Ximen Changhai, the most difficult one. Ximen Changzai meant to muddle through in a low key. However, trouble keeps knocking at the door. Gao Damao, the leader of the Celestial Pool Gang, the sovereign of the Five Poison Sect and others all come to him. Most dangerously, Ximen Changzai arouses the attention and suspicion of Eunuch Cao!

name: Voces American History: The Untold History of Latinos
summary:
American Historia takes Leguizamo's passion from the stage and puts him on the road on a chronological journey traveling throughout Mexico and the U.S. to shed light on both the known and lesser-known stories of Latino history.

Inspired by Leguizamo's own multi-faceted style, each episode will combine cultural travel segments as well as entertaining interstitials, unveiling Leguizamo's passionate revelations about his favorite Latino figures. The cultural segments will feature visits to historical sites as well as interviews with notable historians and Latino cultural figures. Locations and interviewees to be announced at a later date.

name: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
summary: A documentary series focusing on murder cases that remained unsolved for decades and were ultimately cracked with DNA evidence. It explores these stunning scientific developments – as well as the unwavering dedication of families and investigators – that eventually brought the killers to justice.

name: Our Vietnam War
summary: Our Vietnam War tells the story of Australia's involvement in the words of the men who were sent to fight; the battles, the protests, returning and the long shadow the war cast on the people whose lives were turned upside down.

name: Te Quiero y Me Duele
summary: After sparking a rebellious romance, teens Juan Gris and Lola fight encroaching gentrification with the power of music.

name: Gold Coast Ocean Rescue
summary: Gold Coast Ocean Rescue gives viewers a front row seat aboard the drama-packed missions of the Sea World Foundation as they work tirelessly to protect the world's most vulnerable marine creatures. From rescue to rehab, no mission is too risky for this dedicated team of vets and marine scientists, whether that means wrestling with man-eating sharks, releasing distressed whales from fishing nets, or even removing a polar bear's sore tooth.

name: Battle for Dream Island
summary: Twenty characters battle for a luxurious island in an elimination-centric monthly animated series.

name: When Whales Walked: Journeys in Deep Time
summary: Discover the evolutionary secrets of some of the world's most majestic creatures. From voracious crocodiles and acrobatic birds to stupendous whales and majestic elephants, When Whales Walked: Journeys in Deep Time follows top scientists on a global adventure as they follow clues from the fossil record and change what we thought we knew about the evolution of iconic beasts.

name: Australia from Above
summary: This landmark aerial series will focus on The Great Barrier Reef, the Outback, Western Australia, and Sydney and New South Wales. Beyond the breath-taking scenery and dramatic landscapes, the series will also focus on human activity, whether it's an indigenous dance ceremony, tourists swimming with whales or a camel road train across the desert. Shot in 4K the series will utilise a state-of-the art helicopter mounted GSS Cinema Pro Gimbal and high-end inspire drones for harder to access places.

name: Big Zuu's 12 Dishes in 12 Hours
summary:
In Big Zuu's 12 Dishes in 12 Hours, Big Zuu will teach his famous travel companions everything they need to know about a place through tasting 12 dishes. 

Whether it's trying local street food or uncovering new gastronomic trends, through his culinary lens Zuu will guide both viewers and his celebrity guests across a number of cities as they seek out the destinations hidden gems, food markets, local eateries and fine dining restaurants showcasing a never before seen side to some of Europe's most vibrant destinations.

name: One Night Stand
summary:
This is the story of three friends, renowned in their university. Phaphaeng, fierce and direct, is dubbed the "Queen of One Night Stands." Gale is rich, with the air of a luxurious princess. Queen is their mysterious leader.

The morning after a night of fun, when one of three friends is mysteriously murdered, the two remaining girls become suspects in her death. They soon begin searching for the truth behind the events of that night. The stress of the situation turns their friendship upside down.

name: Club Friday The Series 15: Love Never Dies
summary:
Rinthan and Saphol are each others' first loves. They'd planned their entire lives together: their marriage, home, children. Everything's shattered when Saphol suddenly passes away in an accident. Shocked an devastated, Rinthan makes an earnest wish for Saphol to return so they can live their happy future and she begins to live her life as if he were still alive. 

With Saphol's image clinging to her, Rinthan cannot live a normal life, cannot begin to start a new life with someone new. Always by her side is her sister Paithong. Paithong is in love with Joong who's in her faculty. It's a different kind of love, one where feelings are hidden, or they manifest in quarrelling. Rinthan wonders why a love like hers and Saphol's had to be broken when love that doesn't look like love perseveres.

name: Tales of the Grandmaster
summary:
Nalinya's life reaches a turning point when she accidentally falls off of the Ching Dao cliff. At the bottom, she meets a strange guy. He's no ordinary man, but a martial artist from the Chinese wuxia novel she's translating.

Wang Yi Tian, the leader of the Cloud Tiger sector, was assassinated in the martial world. However, by some miracle, he was brought into a new world. Here, he falls in love with Nalinya and begins to protect her as she too seems to be the target of assassination.

name: Bunga Sari
summary: A half-Thai Chinese-Maly orphanage girl, Bunga, lives with her granny Kimluan and makes a living by tapping rubber in the Southern part. Unfortunately, granny is deceived by Boss Wieng to sign the loan agreement and offer Bunga as insurance. When Bunga is about to become Wieng's mistress, she escapes and gets on the train to Pattani province and meets her first love, Tawan, there. At the time Kimluan is seriously ill, Bunga and Tawan return home, but they are chased by Wieng. During the survival escape, Bunga falls overboard and gets lost in the storm. The couple must separate without knowing how good or bad the other is. But it seems like fate works in a strange way; it brings them to meet again, but Bunga forgets Tawan already and becomes another man's fiancée.

name: Fake It Till You Make It
summary: Tang Ying, a junior lawyer going through a tough time meets a young man called Xu Zi Quan. Things happen and the two end up pretending to date.

name: The Evidence Tells
summary: Two women Bai Lu, a police officer, and Gu Yu, a forensics doctor, teams together to solve cases.

name: My Gaming Girlfriend
summary: The game character Jiang Yuyan unexpectedly comes to the real world. She receives the help of a game designer, Qin Yi, but she mistakenly takes his partner Chen Hongfeng as the Third Prince from the game world.However, Chen Hongfeng uses Jiang Yuyan to harm Qin Yi. In the end, Jiang Yuyan exposes Chen Hongfeng's conspiracy and assists Qin Yi in completing his creation.The feelings between the two intensify rapidly. After they confess their love and their romantic relationship reaches fruition, Jiang Yuyan suddenly disappears. She returns to the game world once again…

name: MarkKim + Chef
summary: Thai superstars Kimberley Ann Woltemas and Mark Prin Suparat love food, but their cooking skills could use some sharpening. With their wedding fast approaching, the couple decides to tackle another commitment: learning to cook from professional chefs.

name: Psycho Kitty
summary: The world's #1 cat behaviorist Pam Johnson-Bennett shows cat owners how to do the previously unthinkable: TAME THEIR CATS!

name: Familjen Andersson
summary: Karin, Rudolf and their three children Anna, Sune and Håkan live in the small town of Glimmerdagg. Just like all parents, they try to make the everyday puzzle work, it's just that everyday life is rarely mundane with this family...

name: Överlevarna
summary: Six Swedish comedians compete to survive outside civilization. The survivors are Sissela Benn, Nisse Hallberg, Evelyn Mok, Torbjörn Averås Skorup, Christoffer Nyqvist and Johanna Hurtig Wagrell. Claes Malmberg is a merciless judge.

name: Patterns
summary: We all navigate in multiple social circles - friendships, family, work - and often these groups do not mix. Patterns takes this concept and creates a universe of characters and narratives who move between these circles and finds the comedy within. The series touches on a range of topical issues including, LGBTQ matters; family problems; conspiracy theories; and reality television.

name: The Wedding War
summary: Nobody dreams of marriage these days because of money. A total of 10 couples gather as they need the prize money of 290,000 dollars to get married. With the power of trust and love, which couple will be able to reach the finish line called marriage? A completely new survival game with 10 unmarried couples gets revealed!

previousepisode.name: Who Is Taylor Irksome;George-Zilla;Kidsky And Klutch

name: Popporn
summary: Comedians roasting gay porn movies. What's weird, what's strange, what's hilarious, what's gross, what's surprising, what's enticing? Nothing will escape their comedic wrath!

name: Första Dejten Teens
summary: Now is the time for the young people to step into the action. For the first time ever, Första dajten accepts teenagers between 16-19 years of age.

name: På Riktigt?!
summary: Three people claim to have different talents and skills and a panel of celebrities must find out who is fake and who is real. During the season, among others, David Sundin, Nikki Amini, Robert Gustafsson, Filip Dikmen and Keyyo will appear on the panel. Host is Farah Abadi.

name: Min Tjockumentär
summary: My name is Fredrik Boltes and I have yo-yo dieted all my life. I have tried every diet method out there but still weigh over 160 kilos and find it difficult to live a normal life with my son. In the end I decide to do gastric bypass surgery, but how dangerous is gastric bypass surgery? Can't I lose weight in other ways? What will life be like after the operation? And who the hell pays for the party? For eight years, friends and colleagues filmed me before, during and after the operation. The result is a dead-serious half-baked documentary series. There will be reggae, satire, hard-cut expert interviews, stand-up and a dose of mushrooms under the scrotum. Welcome to my thick documentary.

name: Untold: Swamp Kings
summary: This docuseries explores how legendarily ruthless football coach Urban Meyer turned the ragtag 2000s-era Florida Gators into a ferocious winning machine.

name: Ruckus in Dutchess
summary: A unique group of twenty-somethings living and working together at a Black-owned BBQ bistro in rural-conservative New York.

name: Taali
summary: Presenting the story of Shreegauri Sawant's fight for India's third gender.

name: Wild Fighters
summary:
From the Iberian Peninsula to the world, animals live in continuous fight to ensure their survival. But what are the reasons that make them risk their lives every day? What are the consequences of winning or losing these battles?

There are thousands of types of fight: from hand-to-hand encounters, to dancing, singing, or animal beauty pageants. Behind these fights, there are hidden motives related to mating, hierarchy, territory defense, protection of the family clan and of course, food. At the end of the day, human and animal conflicts are not so different. Welcome to the natural ring of Wild Fighters! Let the show begin!

name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
summary: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises. The new series will see the clubhouse expanding with a brand-new area just for Minnie and the addition of Duffy the Disney Bear, Mickey's trusted teddy bear, who will make surprise appearances in multiple episodes.

name: Doc McStuffins: The Doc & Bella Are In!
summary: In this brand new short-form series inspired by Disney Junior's Peabody Award-winning "Doc McStuffins," Doc welcomes Bella Bunnynose, an adorable plush bunny who dreams of being a toy doctor just like Doc. Bella joins the toys in the clinic and learns from Doc as her intern.

name: Mickey Mouse Specials
summary: A series of special animations featuring Mickey Mouse and his friends.

previousepisode.name: Mickey and the Very Many Christmases

name: Robo⚡️Gobo
summary: After being given super-powered Robo-Suits by kid inventor Dax, his five adorable adopted pets, Booster, Allie, Hopper, Shelly and Wingo are on a mission to save other pets in trouble and learn how to become a family in the process.

name: Ms. Fantastic Miracle Doctor
summary: Jian Mo, a well-known modern acupuncture doctor, had an electric leakage accident in the hospital, and accidentally passed through the body of Yue Wuyan, who is in love with the wind. When he woke up, he found that he had been stabbed in the abdomen and fell in the wild. He also accidentally met the male protagonist Feng Qingcheng. This is a romantic comedy of mishaps. When a modern doctor with excellent medical skills meets a charming and mysterious son Pianpian, who disguises himself as a man and seeks power in the court, misplaced love is quietly coming.

name: Become a Fashion Icon
summary: Long Mengli, the third princess of the Northern Liang Dyansty, was betrayed by her sweetheart and sentenced to death. By chance she came to the 21st century and inhabited the body of a young girl whose dream was to become a fashion designer. After learning that she could start life anew if she fulfilled the former soul's original wish, she became determined to enter the fashion industry, but in the process she actually fell in love with it. And through it all was Bai Yu, the man who always stood by her side, silently supporting and protecting her.

name: Me & Winnie the Pooh
summary: Winnie the Pooh stars in vlog-style shorts.

name: Sew Fierce
summary: Sew Fierce is a Canadian drag competition series showcasing the craft of drag, where designers and costumers compete in weekly challenges to create new looks, hosted by Barbada de Barbades and with design mentor Jaime Lujan aka Lucinda Miu. Eight of the world's top drag designers compete to win the first ever drag designer competition and a cash prize of $10,000.

name: Sorcières
summary: Fate forces three sisters to reunite 30 years after they last met. Having grown up in a town founded by their father, they now lead lives marked by the traumas of their childhood.

name: Neuseeland - Rivalen der Urzeit
summary: New Zealand, the remote archipelago at the end of the world, is an evolutionary treasure trove. Species have been able to develop and survive here undisturbed for eons, which in other parts of the world would have long since succumbed to the pressure of competition, especially from mammals. Primeval reptiles, grotesque ratites and bizarre underwater creatures live here and in neighboring Australia. This series undertakes ambitious expeditions to get the animals in front of the camera and also chronicles the dangers they have faced since the arrival of humans on the volcanically and tectonically shaped islands.

name: Hidden Lives
summary: Writers delve into lesser-known aspects of Scottish society, explore the customs, passions and pastimes that rarely hit the headlines yet give communities a sense of identity.

name: All or Nothing: Die Nationalmannschaft in Katar
summary: The German national football team wants to be the world's best once again at the World Cup in Qatar. After being eliminated in the preliminary round of the 2018 World Cup and in the last 16 at the 2021 European Championship, the former world champions want another title. But again their journey ends in the preliminary round. Exclusive behind-the-scenes insights show their dramatic failure.

name: Bathroom Stories
summary: Best friends Flo and Isa move in together. The twenty-somethings spend a lot of time in the bathroom, where they really get to know themselves and occasionally others.

previousepisode.name: Na het sabbatjaar gaan de vriendinnen hun eigen weg

name: House Hunters: Amazing Water Homes
summary: Love of Water combines with imagination to create Amazing Water Homes.

previousepisode.name: Looking for High Ground in Hilo

name: The Music Freaks
summary: The Music Freaks follows Jake, a popular high school student who hides his passion for singing out of fear of his judgmental friends. That is until one day, when his crush Daisy convinces him to join the music club to compete in a band competition. This series follows Jake and the music club as new friendships, romances and drama evolves leading up to the competition.

name: Kultus
summary: Syakilla, a Singaporean girl studying in New York, inadvertently gets herself embroiled in ELIXR, a cult based in Upstate New York. Her brother, Syafik, travels to Upstate New York and braves the frigid winter cold to help save his sister from the cult. But despite his best efforts, both Syafik and Syakilla will soon realise that there is no escaping ELIXR.

name: O, Wo De Chong Fei Da Ren
Genghis Khan's Mongolia
summary: Historians look at the reign of Genghis Khan, the khagan who united Mongolian tribes and exerted military force to build one of the largest empires in human history.

name: Don't Look Down
summary:
A group of brave celebrities take on TV's scariest challenge show in aid of Stand Up To Cancer.

Over six weeks, the celebs will be coached to conquer their fears as they face a series of physically and mentally demanding training exercises and tasks designed to transform them from total beginners to those capable of scaling the heights. It will be an emotional journey as they must encourage each other and work as a team, while also overcoming their individual anxieties.

At the end of training, the group face the challenge of a lifetime - the most nerve-wracking and vertigo-inducing high wire walk imaginable, as they cross a distance of 1,000ft, 300ft feet above London. All they must remember is the key advice: Don't Look Down!

name: Drama Queens, chez Paloma
summary: Welcome to the official Drag Race France Season 2 aftershow. Settled comfortably on her sofa, Season 1 winner Paloma hosts one of her sisters each week to watch and debrief the latest episode. Amidst laughter and emotion, the Season 1 queens comment on the performances of the new queens. LE-GEN-DARY looks (or not), challenges, gossip, and advice—everything is scrutinised by the alumni with kindness and, above all, total candour.

name: Encore vous ?
summary: Alex Ramirès welcomes on his sofa the greatest shots of series and cinema. A show like you've never seen before, with guests you've probably seen before. YOU AGAIN ? It's your fake talk show that invites and has fun with the clichés of cinema and series. In each episode, Alex Ramirès receives a character who embodies a "trope". It's very META as they say in the movies. It's like the recipe for French toast: take everything that remains in our avid brains for fiction and make a new gourmet/crunchy dish that assumes its references and revisits them without smelling of cinnamon.

previousepisode.name: La scientifique qui a fait une découverte mais que personne n'écoute

name: Slag Wars
summary:
Slag Wars follows Rebecca and Sophie's search for the next LGBTQ+ icon. 

Slag Wars is back for season 2, with new slags and new challenges starting on September 17. Hosted by Rebecca More and Fantasia Royale Gaga this go around.

name: La Dernière Aventure du ComteLance Dur
summary: At the birthday party of an old King closer to the end of his life than the beginning, a mysterious witch interrupts the festivities and kidnaps several children, including the young princess of the Kingdom. Despite his advanced age, his tired bones and his apparent weakness, the King decides to take up arms one last time, to go and rescue the children. This is how he embarks on what will be his very last adventure, accompanied by his old comrades, also crumbling, but more than ever motivated to shine once again.

name: Moitié.e.s
summary: What if the perfect couple didn't exist? Short humorous program imagined by Pauline Clément, Moitié.e.s talks about love and has fun with the contemporary evolutions of the couple. In each episode, Pauline Clément embodies a different character within a singular couple: free, postpartum, toxic, remote... In the form of intimate interviews, the halves will share their daily life, their sentimental or sexual life and their way to love each other in their own way.

name: Air Cocaïne
summary: On March 20, 2013, a private jet was spectacularly boarded by Dominican stups at Punta Cana airport. On board: 26 suitcases filled with 700 kilos of cocaine, two former Navy fighter pilots, a business bringer and a disturbing passenger. This is the beginning of an incredible soap opera, marked by river trials on both sides of the Atlantic, opposing versions, an amazing escape, and a surprising gallery of characters.

name: Mariés au premier regard
summary: Relationship experts pair off ideal couples who then go on to get married upon their first ever meeting. After six weeks together they have to decide whether to stay married

name: Culbute : Nos sexualités sous influence
summary: Movies, series, advertisements, video games, pornography or fairy tales... without us realizing it, these images and stories influence our sexuality. Since childhood, they unconsciously build our desires, define standards and inspire our daily practices.

name: Don't Eat the Neighbours
summary: Rabbit lives in a forest in England with his children: Lucy, Peter, and Emily. Wolf, who has been driven out of Canada by the Brotherhood of Wolves, moves in next door with his sons Barry and Simon. Although Wolf has a strong desire to eat Rabbit, his children develop close friendships with Lucy, rejecting traditional dietary preferences.

name: Les Traîtres : Seront-ils démasqués ?
summary: It is in a castle that 14 personalities will participate in a game of lies, manipulation and betrayal where all shots will be allowed. Among the players, 3 will be designated as "traitors", the others will be "loyal". Day and night, the "traitors" will have to lie about their true identity, develop strategies to deceive the "loyal" and ensure their place in the game. And above all avoid eliminations to arrive last and win the game!

name: Top Chef : La brigade cachée
summary: During the last round, candidates who have not yet joined a brigade will compete to try to win their place in the competition. This time, the chefs will choose their favorite dish blind. They will therefore select an ultimate candidate for their brigade, without knowing who it is. Attention, the stake is crucial because the candidates who are not selected risk elimination...

name: Les Cinquante
summary: In a castle lives an owner who, hidden behind his lion mask, likes to have fun... He has decided to challenge 50 players in the biggest game ever organized.

name: Des gens bien ordinaires
summary: Romain, 18, is a sociology student. In rebellion against his native environment and imprisoned in a toxic romantic relationship with a woman who has total control over his life, he thinks he can find in the pornographic adventure a way of emancipation. Instead he discovers a very ordinary environment.

name: Un dimanche à la campagne
summary: Far from the tumult, Frédéric Lopez invites a few celebrities for a weekend to offer them a timeless moment conducive to confidences. Between emotion and giggles, everyone reveals themselves.

previousepisode.name: Lara Fabian, Manu Payet, Pauline Déroulède

name: Attraction
summary: Agathe likes to describe herself as a mother "like any other". In a charming house, with a talented husband and healthy children, everything seems perfect. However, after 15 years of marriage, the pretty postcard begins to crack... The day a murder is committed in the hotel where her husband was staying for work, an unbearable suspicion sets in... Is the man she shares her life with a murderer? Has she not been trapped in an abusive and toxic relationship for years? What does she really know about Fred? With the emergence of doubt, Agathe plunges into an obsession, and the family unit becomes the arena of a high-tension criminal investigation. Like the fears of our childhood, the monster is no longer in the cupboard, it is in the bed.

name: L'Affaire d'Outreau
summary: The story of the incredible judicial fiasco which lasted 4 years of proceedings and 2 trials to arrive at the acquittal of 13 innocent people who served 3 years in prison.

name: Le Big Show
summary: From the Marigny Theater, Jarry will show all the colors to the spectators! Surprises, hidden cameras, moving reunions, games, dream gifts, unexpected happenings, surprise karaoke with our favorite stars: no one in the room is safe from the surprises and pitfalls of the Big Show! The Big Show is family entertainment that offers viewers an evening of humor and emotion with a multitude of funny and moving surprises!

name: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?
summary: This new magazine, presented by Marie Drucker, focuses on "Cold cases". Closed cases, deemed insoluble, which have sometimes withstood the tenacity of investigators for nearly 50 years before a forgotten clue, unexpected testimony or innovative scientific expertise confuses the culprits. Alongside Marie Drucker, criminologist Alain Bauer sheds a technical, psychological, sociological or historical perspective on each case in order to understand the procedures implemented during the investigation, but also its issues and its repercussions. Each news item tells not only about the evolution of the investigation methods of the police and gendarmerie, but also an era, an environment, a region, a historical or social context. Through the story of the crimes and their resolution, Au bout de laquête will write a little-known page in the history of French society every Saturday.

previousepisode.name: Affaire Jonathann Daval : Le meurtrier qui a trompé la France - Épisode 2

name: Lac-noir
summary: City cop Valerie, 42, transfers with her son Dave, 17, to Lac-Noir, a serene secluded village in the Laurentian forest.

name: 100% logique : La réponse est sous vos yeux
summary: The first quiz that does not test general culture and knowledge, but logic, observation skills and the common sense of viewers! Who will be able to thwart all the traps, and get to the ultimate question? This quiz event will allow viewers to test their logic, their common sense, but also to measure themselves against all the other members of the family!

name: Le Meilleur Pâtissier : La cuisine secrète de Mercotte
Détox ta maison, 7 jours pour tout ranger
Freiheit ist das Einzigste, was zählt
Bra Surr
summary: Alix Ndengeyinka talks to fearless young people and takes the time on what is important to young people today.

previousepisode.name: Lurar vi oss själva att vi är deprimerade?
